email.subject: Harri Kiljander — opportunity to explore Innovation Partner in Residence with Futurice
email.body:
Hello Harri Kiljander,

I have been following Futurice's work — Futurice European digital innovation + software consultancy hai — organizations ko digital products aur services design, build, scale karne mein help karti hai. Finland, Germany, U.

I would be glad to explore advisory support around innovation partner in residence, particularly where product, AI, and organizational change need to move in concert rather than in parallel.

My background spans systems thinking, product strategy, ai transformation, innovation, and I am especially drawn to founder-led environments where ideas, products, and systems can be woven together with clarity and pace.

Would you be open to a short conversation?

Warm regards,
Ankit
